title: SONG IN THE NIGHT
MIDNIGHT SEARCH
end: The Midnight Watch — stand in prayer at midnight
stock_queries: dim candle lamp burning in quiet room night
ancient holy bible open under warm candle flame night
deep starry midnight sky over tranquil still mountain lake
ancient stone chapel sanctuary interior dim lantern glow midnight
quiet midnight watchtower window looking at starry heavens
calm night lake reflection dark forest silhouettes stars
gently flickering prayer lamp in dark peaceful sanctuary

scenes.a: Your quiet room holds a restless memory tonight.
As the hour turns, the psalmist writes:
I call to remembrance my song in the night: I commune with mine own heart: and my spirit made diligent search.
Lord, in this dark hour, when forgotten melodies feel far away, we bring our quiet questioning before You.
Search our hearts where heavy sorrow lingers, and stir the steady praise we thought was lost.
Grant true diligence to our seeking spirit until Your calm presence restores our hope tonight.
In this silent hour, we place every deep search into Your hands. Amen. Your quiet room holds a restless memory.
